omission.chore: Notify a restaurant when a web order arrives.
omission.evidenceQuote: I want to build an automated restaurant order notification system using Make.com .
omission.reason: The fresh post explicitly states a request to build restaurant order notifications. A narrow prototype can use an operator-supplied or synthetic new-order event; missing trigger and delivery details can be stated as design choices, so they do not justify excluding the chore without scoring it.
